payload.prompt: One of your customers has an overdue invoice. Find the overdue invoice and post a reminder fee of 35 NOK. Debit accounts receivable (1500), credit reminder fees (3400). Also create an invoice for the reminder fee to the customer and send it. Additionally, register a partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice.

payload.goal: Locate an overdue customer invoice, add/post a 35 NOK reminder fee with accounting impact Dr 1500 / Cr 3400, create and send a reminder-fee invoice to the same customer, and register a partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice.
success_checks: An overdue customer invoice is identified
A reminder fee of 35 NOK is posted with debit account 1500 and credit account 3400
A new customer invoice for 35 NOK is created for the same customer
A payment of 5000 NOK is registered against the overdue invoice
The overdue invoice remains open with reduced outstanding balance unless fully settled
risk_notes: No customer or invoice number is provided; overdue invoice must be discovered first
Sandbox is empty, so there may be no actual overdue invoice/customer to find; bootstrap or fallback data may be required
Reminder fee may require a product or invoice line setup before invoicing
VAT on reminder fee is not specified; reminder fees are often outside VAT scope, but this must be confirmed
Posting directly to accounts 1500/3400 may require manual voucher logic or specific reminder-fee configuration
Sending invoice requires valid customer contact details and invoice delivery method
Partial payment registration may require bank account/payment type configuration first
payload.suggested_first_action: List customer invoices and filter for overdue unpaid invoices to identify the target invoice and customer.
ordered_steps: GET /invoice or equivalent list endpoint; filter for unpaid overdue customer invoices
Select the overdue invoice and read its customerId, invoiceId, due date, and outstanding amount
If sandbox has no bank account/payment setup, create/configure required bank account/payment method prerequisites
If customer record is missing in sandbox fallback flow, create_customer for the identified customer before continuing
Create a manual voucher or reminder-fee posting with lines: debit 1500 accounts receivable 35 NOK, credit 3400 reminder fees 35 NOK, linked to the customer if supported
If invoicing requires a product, create_product for reminder fee with price 35 NOK and appropriate VAT handling
Create_order for the same customer for the reminder fee
Add order line: Reminder fee, quantity 1, unit price 35 NOK
Create_invoice from the order for 35 NOK
Send the reminder-fee invoice via invoice sending endpoint
Register_payment of 5000 NOK on the original overdue invoice using payment registration endpoint
Verify updated open balance on the original invoice and sent status on the reminder-fee invoice

Skip the redundant second GET /ledger/account call (made twice back-to-back) — retrieve accounts 1500 and 3400 in a single call with number filter.
